neighbours.label: 'because of' / 'due to' introducing the reason someone left or split from a group (the slot where 'creative differences' would follow)
fire: The bassist walked away from the project in 2004 because of tensions with the producer.
After ten years together, the comedy duo broke up due to disagreements over their new show.
The lead actor dropped out of the film because of a dispute with the director.
Two of the founding members quit the band due to arguments about the tour.
The chef resigned from the restaurant because of clashes with the owners.
Our original guitarist left the group because of differences with the rest of us.
The writer stepped down from the series due to conflicts with the network.
The partners dissolved the design studio because of a falling-out over its direction.
quiet: The bassist walked away from the project in 2004 and started a solo career.
After ten years together, the comedy duo released their new show on television.
The lead actor was late to the set because of traffic on the highway.
Two of the founding members joined the band again for the anniversary tour.
The restaurant closed early due to a power outage in the neighborhood.
Our original guitarist still plays with the group at every summer festival.
The writer finished the series ahead of schedule with help from the network.
The flight was delayed because of snow on the runway.

notes: Card: top examples are 'diverg|ences', 'из-|за' (разногласий), 'Director' (Creative), 'led by' (Creative Director); output promotes ' creative'. Probe: 'left the band because of' fires above the corpus max, 'game cancelled because of rain' ~0.2. Also fires before job titles ('led by the studio's chief'), not tested here.
